resources.string: Multi-select batch actions for conversations, providers and assistants in RikkaHub

Version %1$s
What it does RikkaHub only lets you act on one item at a time. This module puts a small draggable button on the right edge of RikkaHub. Tap it to open a multi-select panel:
Conversations Pin / unpin / move to another assistant / delete
Providers Enable / disable / delete (built-in ones are re-added by RikkaHub\'s own normalisation, so they can only be enabled or disabled; use RikkaHubNoSPON if you really need to delete them: github.com/elyezyc/RikkaHubNoSPON)
Assistants Delete (same as RikkaHub itself: their conversations and memory files are cleaned up too)
How to use 1. Load it with Vector (recommended, github.com/JingMatrix/Vector): needs Magisk or KernelSU with Zygisk; flash the system module and reboot. 2. Open the Vector manager from the system notification and enable RikkaHubMultiSelect. 3. Tick RikkaHub in the module scope, package name me.rerere.rikkahub. 4. Force-stop RikkaHub, then open it again. 5. On the chat page a "Multi-select" button shows up on the right edge. Drag it anywhere, tap it to open the panel.
How to verify - The panel lists your conversations, providers and assistants. - In the Vector log page, filter for RikkaHubMultiSelect to see injection and batch results.
Notes - The module calls RikkaHub\'s own data layer by reflection (ConversationRepository, SettingsStore, Room). It never writes the database directly and does not modify the host APK. - Destructive actions cannot be undone; the confirmation dialog shows how many items are affected. - The button position is stored inside RikkaHub\'s app data and goes away with it. - Hooks are installed by class/method name and were verified against RikkaHub 3.3.0 source. A major host rewrite may break them; failures are only logged and never harm the host app. - Licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
